title: He Lived in Her Attic for 10 Years
sources: Wikipedia, 'Walburga Oesterreich': met sewing-machine repairman Otto Sanhuber in 1913 in Milwaukee; he lived hidden in the attic, read and wrote stories she mailed to publishers, did housework by day; moved to the attic of the couple's Los Angeles home; Fred Oesterreich was shot in August 1922 and Walburga was found locked in a closet; the secret came out in 1930; the press called Sanhuber 'The Bat Man'; manslaughter conviction but freed by the statute of limitations
Atlas Obscura, 'The Married Woman Who Kept Her Lover in the Attic'
LAist, 'Hidden History of LA: the lover who lived in a Silver Lake attic' (2016)
